summary: hp victus ai system state baseline
detected_fault: BSOD errors on boot-up, failure to install Windows 11 or other operating systems, freezing, hanging, or kernel panic during installation
suggested_solution: Try booting into a live session of Ubuntu via USB to rule out RAM as the cause.
Check for driver updates and install necessary drivers for the device.
Inspect the case for any signs of damage or wear, and consider replacing it if necessary.
Consider using a different storage device or enclosure to rule out issues with the current one.
